anomalies.title: Upstream Payment Processor Outage and Latency Timeouts
anomalies.description: Frequent UPSTREAM_DOWN (502/503) and TXN_TIMEOUT (408) events occurring across multiple merchants on the alliance-instant gateway, triggering repeated gateway retries.
anomalies.root_cause: Capacity degradation, latency spikes, or intermittent outages within the upstream payment processing service provider.
log_references: 2026-08-01T00:01:53.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=TXN_TIMEOUT txn_id=e34d2962-dc57-478d-ab70-da11fe008c8b merchant=merchant_beta user=user_00179 ip=109.174.142.40 status=408 amount_usd=512.84 latency_ms=2765 msg="Transaction timed out waiting for upstream response"

2026-08-01T00:07:04.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=UPSTREAM_DOWN txn_id=bf7fbd14-df1b-473d-a090-5cfa8d7da85a merchant=merchant_beta user=user_00113 ip=133.231.61.64 status=503 amount_usd=107.12 latency_ms=532 msg="Upstream service unreachable"

2026-08-01T00:07:40.000Z [WARN] gateway=alliance-instant event=GATEWAY_RETRY txn_id=89d11291-c640-46dc-9645-b44466014178 merchant=retailco user=user_00151 ip=57.3.36.182 status=502 amount_usd=338.86 latency_ms=490 msg="Retrying request after upstream 5xx error"

anomalies.title: Frequent Ingress TCP Connection Resets
anomalies.description: High rate of CONNECTION_RESET events (status 400 and 500) indicating unexpected socket terminations by peers or load balancer timeouts.
anomalies.root_cause: TCP socket pool exhaustion or overly aggressive idle connection timeout rules on ingress load balancers.
log_references: 2026-08-01T00:03:34.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=CONNECTION_RESET txn_id=2632880f-2e94-47ab-9d9f-d563a30a5d7f merchant=streamline_gmbh user=user_00057 ip=176.166.28.59 status=500 amount_usd=2007.01 latency_ms=270 msg="Connection reset by peer"

2026-08-01T00:05:18.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=CONNECTION_RESET txn_id=9013293c-6a6e-4e9e-a676-2b63356d281d merchant=quickcart user=user_00193 ip=69.174.57.76 status=500 amount_usd=18.21 latency_ms=1303 msg="Connection reset by peer"

anomalies.title: Merchant Webhook Notification Delivery Failures
anomalies.description: Repeated WEBHOOK_FAILED errors logged when asynchronous payment notifications fail after 3 delivery retries.
anomalies.root_cause: Unreachable merchant webhook receiver endpoints or client-side HTTP timeouts during event processing.
log_references: 2026-08-01T00:05:10.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=WEBHOOK_FAILED txn_id=2ffb9d29-9b89-4357-bf6e-b4324c720fb2 merchant=quickcart user=user_00153 ip=17.197.195.153 status=400 amount_usd=3402.05 latency_ms=2067 msg="Webhook delivery failed after 3 attempts"

2026-08-01T00:08:48.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=WEBHOOK_FAILED txn_id=be73ef5f-d2ff-4f6e-a80a-c4bf5ee86c4b merchant=quickcart user=user_00120 ip=222.27.50.16 status=400 amount_usd=1244.77 latency_ms=2787 msg="Webhook delivery failed after 3 attempts"

anomalies.title: Client Integration Authentication and API Key Failures
anomalies.description: Continuous API_KEY_INVALID and AUTH_FAILURE events resulting in 401 and 403 HTTP status responses across several merchants.
anomalies.root_cause: Stale or revoked API keys in client application configurations, or misconfigured auth headers in merchant API calls.
log_references: 2026-08-01T00:05:35.000Z [ERROR] gateway=alliance-instant event=API_KEY_INVALID txn_id=597907aa-2651-405e-84eb-381cf9198b7e merchant=retailco user=user_00196 ip=46.54.152.216 status=401 amount_usd=765.88 latency_ms=4166 msg="Request rejected - invalid API key"

2026-08-01T00:11:13.000Z [WARN] gateway=alliance-instant event=AUTH_FAILURE txn_id=8f674693-460a-4291-a924-74e4b6b93bd0 merchant=quickcart user=user_00192 ip=81.29.25.150 status=401 amount_usd=286.27 latency_ms=4127 msg="Invalid credentials provided"

healing_actions.title: Enable Upstream Gateway Failover Circuit Breaker
healing_actions.description: Reroute transaction traffic to secondary payment provider endpoint and open circuit breaker for non-responding primary upstream route.
commands: kubectl exec -it deployment/alliance-instant-gateway -- alliance-cli config set --upstream-failover=true
healing_actions.estimated_impact: Mitigates transaction timeouts and failures caused by primary upstream outage.
healing_actions.approval_reason: Enforced to L2 based on action type 'config_update'

healing_actions.title: Reset Gateway Connection Pool and Increase Idle Timeouts
healing_actions.description: Flush idle connection pools on the alliance-instant gateway instances and update proxy keep-alive settings to prevent peer resets.
commands: kubectl exec -it deployment/alliance-instant-gateway -- alliance-cli net reset-pools
healing_actions.estimated_impact: Reduces socket drops and unexpected connection reset errors.
healing_actions.approval_reason: Enforced to L3 based on action type 'network_reset'

healing_actions.title: Alert Merchants and Re-queue Failed Webhooks to Dead Letter Queue
healing_actions.description: Move failed webhook deliveries into a persistent dead letter queue for retry once merchant endpoints recover.
commands: kubectl exec -it deployment/webhook-service -- webhook-cli dlq re-enqueue --status=failed
healing_actions.estimated_impact: Prevents loss of payment status notifications for merchants.
healing_actions.approval_reason: Enforced to L1 based on action type 'alert_only'

healing_actions.title: Notify Affected Merchants Regarding Credential Errors
healing_actions.description: Trigger automated developer alerts to merchant account owners regarding repeated invalid API key and authentication failures.
healing_actions.estimated_impact: Prompts merchant engineering teams to update expired or invalid API keys.
healing_actions.approval_reason: Enforced to L1 based on action type 'alert_only'
